evidence.reason: The finding identifies a real cleanup-safety defect. On the source-mismatch path, `verify_source_scripts` can raise before `skip_cleanup` is set, so the exception handler calls `stop_owned_process(..., launched=None)` instead of suppressing cleanup before lock ownership is established. The cited test explicitly encodes that unsafe behavior by asserting `stop.assert_called_once()`, so the test must be changed along with moving the guard earlier. This is an ordinary correctness fix, not a new requirement.
